question_text: Compare two ANN applications: recognizing a spoken command from audio features and proposing a missing word from a sentence. Refer to their inputs, outputs and one shared limitation. No detailed language-model architecture is required.
adaptation_rationale: Retains comparison of neural pattern-recognition applications; removes advanced NLP architecture, linguistic semantics and unsupported universal real-time/continuous-learning claims.
solution: The speech system takes audio-derived features, whereas the missing-word system takes a representation of written context. Their outputs are a recognized command/category and a proposed word respectively. Both learn complex patterns from training data; biased or unrepresentative examples can produce incorrect predictions, so an output should not be treated as guaranteed understanding.
partial_credit_notes: Award independent criteria up to the stated total; accept equivalent technically correct wording/solutions.
